model_meta.notice: Synthetic engineering assumptions only; hidden H/S/E are NOT validated real-fish psychological or biological readings. Holdout measures same-generator generalization only.
model_meta.fit: Same eleven behavior/position features and >=0.5 hidden labels for all three backends. Fish hours 0-479 (days 1-20) train; hours 480-719 (days 21-30) chronological holdout. No fitting or tuning on holdout.
model_meta.feature_source: Realized actions and positions over trailing 60 minutes (hour 0 instantaneous); no hidden states, scenarios, event indicators, simulated intake, or future feeding response in X.
model_meta.hour_zero: Initial instantaneous observation is part of training, not a complete 60-minute window.
model_meta.simulation: Independent seeded 1-minute trajectories per virtual fish; fixed daily contexts drive current H/S/E baseline; actual simulated intake additionally reduces H. Offering food is an opportunity, not confirmation of intake. Scheduled disturbance adds transient S. All dynamics, coefficients, and scenarios are engineering assumptions.
model_meta.scenario_checkpoint: Noon (hour 12) on days 1-8 deliberately covers all eight high/low H/S/E combinations for each fish; letters describe generator target, not observed facts or model predictions.

huaban.description: 花斑：稳重、行动相对克制，惊扰后恢复较缓。

hongding.description: 红顶：好奇、爱巡游，探索和靠近新事物的倾向较高。

lanyin.description: 蓝银：敏感、安静，较常靠近遮蔽区。

model_meta.events: Per-fish daily food opportunity at minute-of-day 465+17*index (105-minute window); disturbance at 870+23*index; simulated intake is a separate stochastic event.
model_meta.hmm: Supervised label-anchored Gaussian HMM; each fish filtered independently from its first hour, never smoothing or seeing later observations.
model_meta.probabilities: P(synthetic hidden current-hour state >= 0.5), not continuous state regression, future feeding response, or real-fish inference.
model_meta.parameter_stages: model_parameters are 20-day evaluation fits used for displayed probabilities and holdout scores; full_30_day_parameters are separate all-30-day refits for descriptive use only. They do NOT score the holdout.
